description: Dependency updates for this server. A merge to its branch deploys live through Argo CD and there is no
test cluster: Renovate only opens PRs, never merges. Runs are timed by .github/workflows/renovate.yml (weekly
and on demand), so no schedule here. Every pin carries its version in a `# renovate:` comment beside the digest
or commit, so version and digest change together in one PR.

customManagers.description: A `# renovate: … version=<v>` comment, the digest or commit on the next line (OCI chart targetRevisions, cert-manager image digests, the gateway-api commit, Argo CD's install.yaml URL).
A `# renovate:` comment, then `tag: <v>` and `digest: <d>` on the next two lines (veyq's three images).
A `# renovate:` comment, then `<v>@<digest>` on the next line (Traefik's image tag, veyq-admin in the override). The workflow's renovate-image needs none: the github-actions manager reads it.
A `# renovate:` comment, then `<name>_version: <v>` (k3s in the inventory) or `version: <v>` (the k3s Plan).
A `# renovate:` comment, then a GitHub release-asset URL with its tag (the system-upgrade-controller manifests).

packageRules.description: Fresh upstream releases wait three days (Argo CD 3.6.0 needed a 3.6.1 the next day). The wait is a status check on the branch, never a filter (internalChecksFilter none): a group always carries ALL its updates, so Argo CD's install.yaml (github-tags, waits) and its image (docker) cannot land apart. The PR opens once the check passes (prCreation not-pending; prNotPendingHours above the three days). This repository has no CI, so Renovate's own stability check is the only status: internalChecksAsSuccess makes its success count (otherwise a branch with only renovate/ checks stays 'pending' until prNotPendingHours).

prBodyNotes: install.yaml (by commit) and Argo CD's own image move together in this PR. redis follows install.yaml by itself; dex is removed (remove-dex.yaml).
Check that Traefik and cert-manager support this Gateway API version before merging (their go.mod).
Chart and all four images must name the same cert-manager version.
The image tag in values.yaml must equal the new chart's appVersion; change it by hand if Renovate moved them apart.

packageRules.description: veyq: its pins are veyqctl's alone (veyq ADR 0126) — .github/workflows/veyq-upgrade.yml proposes each upgrade as a PR after verifying the release's manifest, images and chart under veyq's release identity and its major entry, none of which Renovate checks. A second mover on the same lines would be drift to veyqctl.

prBodyNotes: The controller's manifests, its image and its kubectl image. The k3s version in plan.yaml has its own PR.

packageRules.description: k3s versions are v<semver>+k3s<n>; release candidates (-rcN) are prereleases. After raising k3s_version, Renovate runs the checksum script (allowed by name in the workflow's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS) and commits its result in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Raises k3s in the Plan (gitops/apps/system-upgrade/install/plan.yaml) and in the inventory (what a fresh server is installed with); k3s_checksums were written by scripts/update-k3s-checksums.sh. Merging it makes the system-upgrade-controller upgrade k3s on the server: a short outage of everything.
After merging: `cd ansible && ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml -p collections --force`.
